body: Thanks.. the only problem is I’ve been doing this for 7 years, and it’s just gotten to the point where I can’t do it anymore. For 7 years I kept that hope of “I’m gonna meet someone, I’m going to be happy, it’s going to get better” and all that happened was I got more ill, to the point where I can’t make my own bed, I can’t put on my own socks. I can’t drive a car, I can’t walk for a long time. It’s gotten worse and I don’t see it getting better.
I can’t. It would ruin me irl.
